safety.title: Your safety first
safety.body: Remote consultations are not a substitute for emergency care. If you have serious symptoms such as chest pain, difficulty breathing or loss of consciousness, seek emergency help immediately.

q1.q: Is the platform suitable for emergencies?
q1.a: No. In an emergency call 997 or 911, or go to the nearest emergency department.

q2.q: How do I book a consultation?
q2.a: Find a doctor, choose the consultation type and a convenient slot, then complete the booking and payment if the consultation is paid.

q3.q: How do I know a doctor is verified?
q3.a: The “Verified” badge appears on a doctor's profile only after the platform confirms it has reviewed their professional licence details.

q4.a: You can cancel eligible appointments from your appointments page, according to the cancellation policy shown at booking.

q5.q: Who can see my medical record?
q5.a: Your treating doctor can see your medical information within the consultation. Pharmacies only see what is needed to dispense a prescription.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.intro: MedConnect connects patients with doctors through text or video consultations, with electronic prescriptions that can be dispensed at participating pharmacies where available.

about.title: About us
about.body: MedConnect is a Saudi telemedicine platform that aims to make it easier for patients to reach doctors safely and clearly, while respecting the privacy of health data.

patientSafety.title: Patient safety
patientSafety.p1: Remote consultations are suitable for non-emergency conditions only.
patientSafety.p2: Tell your doctor about all medicines you take and any allergies you have.
patientSafety.p3: Only use medicines according to an issued prescription and clear instructions.
patientSafety.p4: If your condition worsens after the consultation, visit the nearest healthcare facility.
